items.title: 25.2 Kuch compounds ki retrosynthesis aur synthesis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of retrosynthesis examples (PDF 137-139).

items: Disconnection: ester ka C-O bond torne se synthon A, acylium ion CH3CO+, aur synthon B, ethoxide ion C2H5O-, milte hain.
Synthetic equivalents: CH3CO+ ethanoic (acetic) acid aur C2H5O- ethanol faraham karta hai.
Synthesis: esterification, CH3COOH + C2H5OH -> CH3COOC2H5 + H2O (garha H2SO4).
FGI: amino group nitro group mein badla jata hai, kyunke nitro group electrophilic substitution se benzene par aasani se lagta hai, jab ke amino group nucleophilic substitution se nahi lag sakta.
Disconnection: nitrobenzene ka C-N bond torne se aryl anion C6H5- aur nitronium ion NO2+ milte hain.
Synthetic equivalents aur synthesis: benzene aur nitric acid; benzene ki nitration (HNO3, H2SO4), phir nitrobenzene ko Sn aur HCl se reduce karein.
Disconnection: ring aur C=O group ke darmiyan C-C bond torne se aryl anion C6H5- aur acylium cation CH3CO+ milte hain.
Synthetic equivalents: benzene aur ethanoyl (acyl) chloride.
Synthesis: Friedel-Crafts acylation, C6H6 + CH3COCl -> C6H5COCH3 + HCl (AlCl3 catalyst).

blocks.alt: Teen panel. Ethyl ethanoate: CH3CO-OC2H5 ke C-O bond par surkh tirchhi lakeer, CH3CO+ (synthon A) aur C2H5O- (synthon B) mein disconnection, SE ethanoic acid aur ethanol, aur esterification ka mua'adla. Aniline: benzene HNO3/H2SO4 se nitrobenzene, jise Sn/HCl aniline mein reduce karta. Phenylethanone: benzene + CH3COCl, AlCl3 ke saath, phenylethanone + HCl.
blocks.caption: Ethyl ethanoate, aniline aur phenylethanone ki retrosynthesis aur synthesis (kitab ki misalon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har misal mein functional group wala bond tora jata, do charge wale synthons asal reagents se milaye jate, aur phir aage ki synthesis pehle se maloom reaction use karti hai: esterification, nitration aur reduction, ya Friedel-Crafts acylation.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Cholesterol ki tareekhi synthesis pehli baar 1950 ki dahai ke shuru mein do muqabil groups ne ki, jin ki qayadat Oxford mein Robert Robinson aur Harvard mein R. B. Woodward kar rahe the.

blocks.prompt: Aniline ki synthesis mein benzene ki nitration kyun ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Amino group seedha benzene par nahi lag sakta, lekin nitro group electrophilic substitution se lag sakta hai; phir nitro group NH2 mein reduce hota hai (FGI).

blocks.prompt: Phenyl ethanoate, CH3COOC6H5, dawaiyan banane mein use hota hai. Is ka retrosynthetic tree, synthetic equivalents aur synthesis batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ester ka C-O bond torein: CH3COOC6H5 => CH3CO+ + C6H5O-. Synthetic equivalents: CH3CO+ ke liye ethanoyl chloride (CH3COCl), aur C6H5O- ke liye phenol (C6H5OH). Synthesis: CH3COCl + C6H5OH -> CH3COOC6H5 + HCl, NaOH jaise base ke saath garam kar ke (phenol khud ethanoic acid se achhi tarah ester nahi banata).

items: Ethyl ethanoate: C-O disconnection; tezaab + alcohol.
Aniline: FGI se nitrobenzene; nitration phir reduction.
